start.description:
Start datetime of the time range. The start date is inclusive of the date mentioned.
E.g. '2010-01-01T00:00:00' (everything starting from '2011-01-01T00:00:00' will be included)

end.description:
End datetime of the time range. The end date is exclusive of the date mentioned.
E.g. '2011-01-01T00:00:00' (everything before '2011-01-01T00:00:00' will be included)

_size.description: length of this time-info in intervals. I.e. size of the timeseries this info represents.

_isAligned.description: true if time range is aligned with interval.

dimensions.description:
Every metric has specific characteristics that describe it, and you can think of dimensions as categories for
those characteristics. You can assign up to ten dimensions to a metric.

statistic.description: AWS cloud watch metric statistic / aggregation function.
